3532-5078-7750-8346.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7750-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

687-2034-6774-8130.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a creature you control.
687-2034-6774-8130.description:
Activate Wall of Roots by putting two -0/-1 counters on it (due to Loading Zone), adding {G}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
In response to Tayam's ability, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wall of Roots, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Wall of Roots from your graveyard to the battlefield with two vigilance counters on it due to Tayam and Loading Zone.
Repeat.
687-2034-6774-8130.notes: This order of operations and the {2} starting mana are necessary because you cannot pay the counter removal cost before sacrificing the creature to Ashnod's Altar, due to the timing sequence of the activated ability rules.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1626-3249-4549--206.description:
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Headless Rider triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that Zombie from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.
728-1626-3249-4549--206.notes: Some of the one-drop Zombie creatures in the template adds more powerful results, and Gravecrawler does not require Havengul Lich.

1479-2841-4288-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-4288-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

240-728-969-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-969-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-2829-3375-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-3375-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4186-5662-5686--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

2034-7084-7885.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4067-7069-7890.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a land
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Moritte of the Frost each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

413-1580-4871-7316.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Rat King and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

427-3457-7791.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn two or more cards this turn.
427-3457-7791.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Kydele.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Kydele.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3368-4309-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least four cards this turn.
3368-4309-4668.description:
Cast Electrodominance, choosing X=3, but paying {R}{R} due to Heliod
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {R}{R} due to Heliod
Resolve Reiterate, copying Electrodominance and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Electrodominance, dealing 3 damage to any target, and allowing you to pay {0} to cast Reiterate with buyback due to Electrodominance and Heliod
Repeat from step 3.

49-2034-4871-7147-7646.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Krallenhorde Howler.
Repeat.

650-891-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

240-2438-4359-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

1563-2457-4742-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4002-4331-4993-7010.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4331-4993-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
4002-4331-4993-7010.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3617-6122-6991.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Donnie & April by paying its mana cost.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Donnie & April from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
3617-6122-6991.notes: If you cast Donnie & April from the command zone to start, you must be able to pay for commander tax that first turn.

2866-3518-4986-5226.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

2173-2921-5220-6538.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1621-6747-6867.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1621-6747-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-4613-5427-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Tor Wauki the Younger.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3750-4447-6704.easyPrerequisites:
RMS Titanic is a creature or other creatures you control have power 3 or greater.
An opponent cannot block RMS Titanic.
3750-4447-6704.description:
If needed, activate RMS Titanic's crew ability by tapping any number of creatures with power 3 or greater,  causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Assault Suit's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to RMS Titanic.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using RMS Titanic, triggering its ability, causing you to not sacrifice it due to Assault Suit and create nine Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

225-5413-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-5413-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat from step 9 for each remaining Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

654-1445-2366-3129-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
654-1445-2366-3129-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-1447-1734.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1429-2438-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-2438-5402.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3604-5315-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
3604-5315-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
When Lonis enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Lonis.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat from step 3.
3604-5315-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

2089-2351-2440.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
2089-2351-2440.description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher's first ability riggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Symmetry Matrix and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Tentacle on the battlefield.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2493-2564-3603-4231.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1497-1947-2646-3763.notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
1497-1947-2646-3763.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Wild Cantor by paying {R/G}.
Wild Cantor enters the battlefield, triggering Paleoloth, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing itself, adding {1}.
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying {1}{R}.
Reckless Barbarian enters the battlefield, triggering Paleoloth, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1846-1987-2397-2493.description:
Cast High Tide.
Tap the Island for {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker targeting Archaeomancer and the Island.
Archaeomancer triggers twice, returning Ghostly Flicker and High Tide from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast High Tide.
Tap the Island for {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker targeting Archaeomancer and the Island.
Archaeomancer triggers twice, returning Ghostly Flicker and High Tide from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast High Tide.
Tap the island for {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat, gaining mana each itteration.

1309-2665-4377.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Salvager of Secrets.
1309-2665-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the token Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
